headline: 仙逆剧场版领跑，女巫团学院开播
summary: 本周影市由《仙逆剧场版：弑仙之战》《挖掘者》等热作领跑；新剧《女巫团学院》《装备我最强》开播，《菜鸟老警》《龙族》等持续热播；《沙丘3》《复仇者联盟5》等待映。

industryHighlights.text: 电影热作：《仙逆剧场版：弑仙之战》《挖掘者》《不存在的罪人》《牢笼鬼魂》《神探之痕迹》受关注。
industryHighlights.en: Movie buzz: Xian Ni: Slaying Immortals, The Digger, The Nonexistent Sinner, Ghost in the Cage, and Detective Traces draw attention.

industryHighlights.text: 新剧首播：《女巫团学院》《装备我最强》本周开播。
industryHighlights.en: New premieres: Witches Academy and Gear Up: I'm the Strongest launch this week.

industryHighlights.text: 热播剧：《菜鸟老警》《瑞克和莫蒂》《龙族》《梦魇绝镇》《黑色丽人》持续在播。
industryHighlights.en: On-air hits: The Rookie, Rick and Morty, House of the Dragon, From, and Black Beauty continue.

industryHighlights.text: 待映电影：《猫鼬》《复仇者联盟5》《另一个妈妈》《泥面人》《沙丘3》排队上映。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming films: Mongoose, Avengers 5, Another Mother, Clayface, and Dune 3 are queued for release.

headlineEn: Xian Ni Leads; Witches Academy Debuts
summaryEn: This week, Xian Ni: Slaying Immortals and The Digger lead movie buzz; new series Witches Academy and Gear Up: I'm the Strongest debut, while The Rookie and House of the Dragon stay hot; Dune 3 and Avengers 5 await release.
